term_value.text: seeking a suitably qualified and competent service provider to deliver services for the BCMDA Annual Report (printing, design, layout, and photography for tourist attraction projects within Buffalo City). The appointment of a professional service provider to offer BCMDA Annual Report (print design, layout and photography for tourist attraction projects within Buffalo City). This is aimed at: 1. Informing the public about the agency’s performance and financial affairs, including revenue generation and expenditure analysis. 2. Ensuring transparency and accountability by providing a record of activities and performance against the budget. 3. Facilitating oversight by allowing stakeholders, including citizens and investors, to evaluate the agency’s financial management and service delivery. 4. Promoting decision-making processes for stakeholders by offering insight into the agency’s financial position and cash flow. 2. SCOPE OF THE WORK The scope of work envisaged covers the following areas: 2.1 Print design, layout and photography for tourist attraction projects within Buffalo City. a. Design concept b. Design and layout of a 172-page annual report, editing of 172-page Annual Report c. Re-layout Annual Financial Statements d. Design includes images, infographics
